div.style: color: rgb(42, 16, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Worm Spider Crab Hexapod as SAC
batch_size 256 · buffer_size 500,000 · buffer_init_steps 10,000
tau 0.005 · steps_per_update 1 · init_entcoef 0.5
lr 3e-4 constant · gamma 0.99 · max_steps 10,000,000

div.style: color: rgb(42, 16, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bipeds keep PPO 512×3 with BipedWalk.demo
gail strength 0.1 · bc strength 0.2 for 500,000 steps
4-stage curriculum keyed on Grandma: Flat → SlopeAndRough
→ DomainRandomization → FullCourseHazards

span.p: ISAAC/boy_tasks/agents/rsl_rl_ppo_cfg.py — RSL-RL PPO on GPU

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

color: rgb(13, 61, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Runner num_steps_per_env 24 · max_iterations 3000 · save_interval 50
experiment_name boy_chase_flat · empirical_normalization true
4096 envs × 24 steps = 98,304 transitions per iteration

div.style: color: rgb(13, 61, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Actor and critic MLP [128, 128, 128], activation elu
obs_normalization true, init_std 1.0
the fitted normaliser is baked into the exported ONNX,
so Unity feeds raw observations

div.style: color: rgb(13, 61, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Algorithm clip_param 0.2 · entropy_coef 0.01 · value_loss_coef 1.0
num_learning_epochs 5 · num_mini_batches 4
learning_rate 1e-3, schedule adaptive with desired_kl 0.01
gamma 0.99 · lam 0.95 · max_grad_norm 1.0 · clipped value loss

div.style: color: rgb(13, 61, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Domain randomisation (startup) body friction static .6-1.0, dynamic .4-.8
spine mass × log-uniform 1/1.25 .. 1.25
(reset) pose ±0.5 m, yaw ±π, velocity ±0.3 m/s, ±0.3 rad/s
(interval) push every 10-15 s at ±0.5 m/s

div.style: color: rgb(13, 61, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Observation noise lin_vel ±0.1 · ang_vel ±0.2 · gravity ±0.05
joint_pos ±0.01 · joint_vel ±1.5 · enable_corruption true
the PLAY config turns all of it off: the reference recording must be deterministic

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Config/BrokenLoco01.yaml — 1-hour attended fine-tune, 2026-09-02

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

color: rgb(74, 10, 46) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
init_path results/all8h_20260826_2244/<Name>/checkpoint.pt
continues from the 8-hour run; global step resets, so max_steps 300,000 counts fresh
summary_freq 10,000 · keep_checkpoints 8 · checkpoint_interval 40,000

div.style: color: rgb(74, 10, 46) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Extrinsic only — BC/GAIL would pull the policy back toward the coded gait,
which is exactly the crawl being escaped

div.style: color: rgb(74, 10, 46) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No curriculum. Every parameter pinned to what the Flat race actually asks:
goal_distance_max 20 · goal_angle_span 0 · rough_amplitude 0 · track_kind 0
hazard_level 0 · quirk_power .08 · quirk_mass .12 · quirk_friction .15
An hour is not long enough to climb the ladder, and the ladder was
training them for goals the race never sets.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 10, 46) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Target: Worm, Spider, Centipede, Crab — the four that do not reach
the finish on the 20 m Flat race. Quad, Hexapod, Kangaroo and Blob are listed
only because Builds/AllEnv contains them. Ship a retrained brain ONLY if it
beats the incumbent in an actual race.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 10, 46) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Caveat, measured: Reward_WormLoco was not told about the 0.005 s step
until 2026-09-02, so every brain trained in that window — broken_loco01 included —
learned against a distorted reward: episodes cut at 5 s of no progress instead of 20,
and every per-step penalty landing 4× per simulated second.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 50, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Why progress, not reward:
the reward is potential-based, so
its scale drifts with episode length.
Progress is a shared clock — every
behavior steps at the same rate, so
slow learners are no longer dragged
along by the Worm score.
completion_criteria still needs a
behavior name; Worm is just the clock.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Config/AllLoco8h02.yaml — 4th-gen unattended 8-hour all-creatures run

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
8 coded-gait behaviors Worm Spider Hexapod Quad Centipede Crab Kangaroo Blob
trainer_type ppo · threaded true
batch_size 2048 · buffer_size 20480 (10 batches per update)
learning_rate 3e-4, schedule linear · beta 0.005 · epsilon 0.2 · lambd 0.95 · num_epoch 3
network: normalize true, hidden_units 256, num_layers 2
max_steps 3,200,000 · time_horizon 1000 · summary_freq 20,000 · checkpoint_interval 250,000

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
reward_signals
extrinsic: gamma 0.995, strength 1.0
gail: gamma 0.99, strength 0.05, demo_path Assets/Demonstrations/<Name>.demo
behavioral_cloning: strength 0.3, steps 400,000

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 biped behaviors Grandma Grandpa Matt Nick (YAML anchor *biped)
same hyperparameters, but network 512 × 3 — the shape ML-Agents uses for its own Walker
NO gail, NO behavioral_cloning — extrinsic only
max_steps 30,000,000: the launcher time box is the real stop,
so these four never reach the progress thresholds the ladder keys off

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Why all thirteen are listed: Builds/AllEnv contains all thirteen behaviors.
A config naming only nine aborts the run at startup — which is exactly
what happened to all8h_20260826_2233.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Promotion rule: evaluate with ELO from actual races (Systems_Elo, K = 32,
default rating 1200), never on mean reward. A potential-based reward scales with
episode length, so a longer-surviving brain scores higher without racing better.
